article_title: Children as young as nine hurt in growing number of e-scooter crashes

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: A new e-scooter racing league for children
A rise in serious e-scooter injuries among children, including some as young as nine
A plan to replace bicycles with rental scooters
A study showing that pavements are safer than roads
tasks.correct_answer: A rise in serious e-scooter injuries among children, including some as young as nine
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בעלייה במספר ובחומרת הפציעות של ילדים בתאונות קורקינט חשמלי, ובהם ילדים בני תשע.

tasks.prompt: Which children were included in the hospital review described in the article?
options: Only adult pedestrians hurt by rental scooters
Children treated at major trauma centres in Liverpool, Manchester and Sheffield
Only teenagers who owned a driving licence
Children injured while riding ordinary bicycles
tasks.correct_answer: Children treated at major trauma centres in Liverpool, Manchester and Sheffield
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסקירה אספה מקרים של ילדים שטופלו במרכזי טראומה מרכזיים בליברפול, מנצ'סטר ושפילד.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “irreversible” mean when describing brain damage?
options: Temporary and easy to treat
Caused only by stress
Impossible to undo or repair
Limited to a broken bone
tasks.explanation_hebrew: irreversible פירושו בלתי הפיך — נזק שאי אפשר לבטל או לתקן.

tasks.prompt: What does the article say about private e-scooter ownership and age?
options: There is no age restriction on owning a private e-scooter
Only people over 21 may own one
Private e-scooters may be owned only by rental companies
Children may own one only with a hospital certificate
tasks.correct_answer: There is no age restriction on owning a private e-scooter
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שאין מגבלת גיל על בעלות פרטית של קורקינט חשמלי, אף שהשימוש בו במרחב הציבורי מוגבל בחוק.

tasks.prompt: Why do the medical experts reject the idea that e-scooters are harmless toys?
options: They are too expensive for most families
They can travel at speed and crashes can cause fractures or lasting brain injuries
They cannot be used indoors
They require more maintenance than bicycles
tasks.correct_answer: They can travel at speed and crashes can cause fractures or lasting brain injuries
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפציעות המתוארות — שברים ואף נזק מוחי בלתי הפיך — מראות שכלי מהיר אינו צעצוע נטול סיכון.

tasks.prompt: What does “mandatory” mean in the discussion of helmet use?
options: Required by a rule or law
Recommended only for adults
Available at a lower price
Forbidden on public roads
tasks.correct_answer: Required by a rule or law
tasks.explanation_hebrew: mandatory פירושו חובה לפי כלל או חוק; הכתבה מציינת שחבישת קסדה אינה חובה בכל שימוש כזה.

tasks.prompt: Give two findings from the article that show the seriousness or pattern of child e-scooter injuries.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני ממצאים מדויקים מן הכתבה על גיל הנפגעים, סוג הפציעות, מקום האירועים או זהות הנפגעים.
expected_points: Some injured children were as young as nine
Reported injuries included fractures and irreversible brain damage
Most incidents happened on public roads
Only a small share of those injured were pedestrians

tasks.prompt: Summarise the evidence, safety concerns and proposed responses in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את העלייה בפציעות, דוגמה לחומרתן, בעיית ההסדרה ותגובה אפשרית אחת לפחות.
expected_points: Trauma centres reported a growing number of injured children
Some injuries were severe, including multiple fractures or lasting brain damage
Private ownership has no age restriction while public use is restricted
Researchers call for clearer regulation, safety information and responsible retailing

tasks.prompt: Why might the gap between easy private ownership and restricted public use create a safety problem for families?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד רכישה קלה עלולה ליצור רושם מוטעה של חוקיות או בטיחות ולהוביל ילדים חסרי ניסיון לרכוב במקומות אסורים.
expected_points: Families can buy a private scooter without an ownership age limit
Buyers may not understand where riding is legal
Children may treat the vehicle as a toy despite its speed and injury risk
Retailers can help by explaining the law and safety precautions

tasks.prompt: Using the article, propose two measures that could reduce serious e-scooter injuries among children and explain why each could help.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע שני צעדים ישימים ולקשור כל אחד מהם לסיכון או לממצא שמופיע בכתבה.
expected_points: Clearer rules or an age restriction for private e-scooters
Mandatory or strongly promoted helmet use
Retailers explaining legal restrictions and risks before sale
Parent education and enforcement against illegal pavement or road use
